strongest_angle: NVentures, LLC filed a motion on November 10, 2026, in the United States District Court for the Northern District of California to quash a deposition subpoena from Universal Music Group and Sony Music Entertainment in their copyright lawsuit against Suno Inc.

key_facts.fact: On November 10, 2026, third-party NVentures, LLC filed a motion to quash a deposition subpoena in the United States District Court for the Northern District of California.
Universal Music Group and Sony Music Entertainment are plaintiffs in a copyright lawsuit against Suno Inc. concerning generative-AI music training data.
NVentures describes itself as a passive minority investor that has already produced documents regarding its pre-investment business relationship with Suno.
The case docket in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California is assigned docket number 3:2026mc80342.

named_entities.name: United States District Court for the Northern District of California
